name: Camp Naticook
description_short: A town-run traditional day camp at Wasserman Park on Naticook Lake in Merrimack, NH, for children entering Kindergarten through 5th grade. Campers do sports, games, arts and crafts, nature activities, swimming, boating, archery and theater, and a daily hot lunch is included.
refund_policy_summary: Each session requires a $50 non-refundable deposit, and the full balance is due 45 days before the session starts. If you cancel at least 30 days ahead, you lose only the deposit. Cancelling 15–30 days ahead gets a 50% refund of what you paid, minus the deposit, and there are no refunds within 15 days of the start. Transfers to another session have no penalty if made at least 30 days ahead. Medical cancellations within 14 days of the start need a doctor's letter and get a 50% refund of the remaining amount, minus the deposit.
special_needs_notes: The camp no longer provides one-to-one aides. Campers must be able to take part in their assigned group and tell staff what they need. Families are encouraged to call the camp to discuss fit. For one-to-one support, the camp suggests Camp Allen (Bedford), Recreational Education Center (Londonderry) or Camp Starfish (Rindge).
swim_waterfront_notes: The camp is on Naticook Lake. Campers go on canoe trips and have free swim time at the waterfront and beach. The page says American Red Cross swim lessons are offered at no extra cost, though that text says "Returning for 2025".
